decision.summary: The Federal Reserve raised its benchmark interest rate by 75 basis points to a target range of 3-3/4 to 4 percent.

changes.quote: In determining the pace of future increases in the target range, the Committee will take into account the cumulative tightening of monetary policy, the lags with which monetary policy affects economic activity and inflation, and economic and financial developments.
changes.explanation: The Fed added language noting that it will consider how past rate hikes and the delay in their effects should guide the speed of future increases.

tone_quotes.quote: The Committee anticipates that ongoing increases in the target range will be appropriate in order to attain a stance of monetary policy that is sufficiently restrictive to return inflation to 2 percent over time.

In determining the pace of future increases in the target range, the Committee will take into account the cumulative tightening of monetary policy, the lags with which monetary policy affects economic activity and inflation, and economic and financial developments.

for_you.text: On a $5,000 card balance at about 15.13% APR, a 75 bp increase raises monthly interest by about $3.13.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury yield, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 4.1% and moved +3 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 6.94% would rise by about $6.03 a month.
High-yield savings rates usually follow the Fed partly; on $10,000 that means roughly $45.00 a year more in interest.
Unemployment was 3.5%, and employers added an average of 408k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: CPI inflation was 8.2% over the past year (September 2022); core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, was 5.6%, against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a 2.7% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield, the most Fed-sensitive market rate, moved +7 bp on the day, and the S&P 500 moved -2.5%.
The broad trade-weighted dollar moved -0.07% on the day.

card.whats_next: The statement signals that further rate hikes remain likely as the Committee works to lower inflation to its 2 percent goal. For educational purposes, the forecast model gave the next meeting probabilities as: hold 2%, cut 0%, hike 98%.

citations.detail: In support of these goals, the Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate to 3-3/4 to 4 percent.
